title: Mobile Phone Waterfall Cost Planner
one_line: Plan and price a mobile number waterfall before it runs: the provider order, the expected find rate, the cost per mobile found, and a cap that stops overspend.
description: Plan and price a mobile number waterfall before it runs: the provider order, the expected find rate, the cost per mobile found, and a cap that stops overspend. Use when someone wants mobile numbers for a call list, compares phone data providers, or needs to know what a phone enrichment will cost.
paragraph: Mobile numbers are the most expensive field in enrichment, and the cost depends on the find rate far more than on the list price. This skill runs a small test across the providers you have keys for, measures what each one finds and what it charges, and turns that into a plan: the order, the expected cost per mobile found at your volume, and a hard cap on provider credits.
keywords: how much will mobile numbers cost

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: mobile-phone-waterfall-orchestrator 0.003 USD per phone search submitted and 0.02 USD per mobile found.
Free. On a python.org install on macOS, run `Install Certificates.command` once, or the script falls back to the system certificate file and says so if it cannot.
